verses.raw: [So it was], until when Our command came and the oven overflowed,<sup foot_note=254583>1</sup> We said, "Load upon it [i.e., the ship] of each [creature] two mates and your family, except those about whom the word [i.e., decree] has preceded, and [include] whoever has believed." But none had believed with him, except a few.
